Times are Asia/Seoul. Newest first.

## 2026-11-08 21:27 · claude-macbook · astoutline-26-3

MC 26.3 moved the GPU API out of com.mojang.blaze3d into com.mojang.renderpearl (api/commands, api/device, api/pipeline, api/textures; GlStateManager/opengl gone from blaze3d). Also: OutputTarget removed, ItemInHandRenderer removed, SubmitNodeCollector.submitItem/submitModel signatures changed, RenderTypes.glint*/entityGlint/armorEntityGlint changed, RenderPass now uses RenderPassDescriptor. Any 26.2 render mod needs real porting, not a version bump.

Outline N' Stuff (astoutline 3.6.0, ARR, closed source, notice forbids modified versions): vs 26.3 = 104 rename-only refs + 26 real API breaks + 3 mixin targets gone (GameRenderer.renderLevel, FeatureRenderDispatcher.renderAllFeatures, RenderTypes.glint). No 26.3 build on Modrinth as of 2026-11-08. Not patching it; only the author can port.

CC0 alternative Enchantment Glint Outline (github.com/Da0neDatGotAway/better-enchants, 3.3 for 26.2): 33 rename-only + 6 real breaks (submitModel/submitItem mixins, glint RenderTypes). Feasible to port from source. Checker scripts: scratchpad compat_check.py / rename_check.py (constant-pool symbol diff vs Modrinth meta/versions jars).
